shellCommands.command: cat .gitignore; ls -la; ls -la app/; ls -la __agent_eval__/ 2>&1; cat package.json
git log --oneline -20; echo "---"; git show HEAD --stat; echo "---"; git show HEAD~1 --stat 2>&1 | head -n 100

find / -name "*.test.*" -o -name "*eval*" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache 2>&1 | head -n 20
grep -r "cacheLife\|cacheTag" /workspace/node_modules/next --include="*.d.ts" | head -n 20

grep -r "cacheLife\|CacheLife" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>&1 | head -n 100
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.js 2>&1 | head -n 100
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-tag.js 2>&1 | head -n 100
